programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Set against the tumultuous lead-up to the 1999 referendum in East Timor and its horrifying aftermath, ANSWERED BY FIRE is a very personal exploration of first-world intervention in third-world traumas. Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Dubai Basketball - Partizan Mozzart Bet Belgrade
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolyga. "Anadolu Efes" - "Maccabi"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When the group arrives at a small Earth Kingdom mining town, they see an earthbender, named Haru, who is practicing his ability, but he runs away when Katara tries to confront him about it. They soon learn that the Fire Nation has taken over the town, that earthbending is forbidden and all earthbenders are taken away to an offshore prison. However, when an elderly man is trapped in a collapsed mine, Katara urges Haru to use his powers to save the man's life, but then, the old man reports Haru to the authorities. Katara blames herself for his predicament and she vows to rescue him, but will she succeed?

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Nuts to You/The Terror of Madagascar Description : Nuts to You: Fred the Squirrel has hit the jackpot. He stumbles onto a jackpot oak tree which is loaded with acorns (that's tons of money to animal folk). He's going to need financial advice, and who better to offer sound advice than King Julien? The two enter a partnership looking for ways to spend on the good life. The Red Squirrel has designs on the loot, though, and captures the hapless twosome in order to squeeze the acorns out of them. Will the evil squirrel's precisely planned plot pay or get him played? The Terror of Madagascar: A special delivery has come from Madagascar. What is it? A baby Fossa! Everyone is enchanted by the little tyke except King Julien, who sees him as a lemur-devouring predator, and he has the toothmarks on his butt to prove it! Julien formulates a plan to get rid of the adorable little carnivore, but his slithery solution becomes much worse than the problem!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: While trying to beat a paddle-ball world record, SpongeBob forgets to feed Gary - for several weeks. Once SpongeBob realizes that he has neglected Gary, he sets out in a town-wide search for him. Meanwhile, as Gary is wrapped in comfy blankets and indulged in and endless assortment of snacks, he discovers a very dark secret about this sweet old woman...

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.desc: La terza stagione vede naturalmente protagonista Paola Cortellesi affiancata da Andrea Pennacchi. Entra in scena Francesco Acquaroli nel ruolo di Luigi, un poliziotto esperto e brillante che con Petra ha un legame speciale.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: 2 Oscar 2018 al sequel del cult di fantascienza diretto da Denis Villeneuve con Harrison Ford e Ryan Gosling. L’agente K scopre un segreto che potrebbe gettare il mondo nel caos.

programme.title: Blue Jasmine
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Cate Blanchett in una pellicola di Woody Allen. Una donna in crisi lascia New York e si trasferisce a San Francisco per rimettere ordine nella sua vita.

programme.title: Laggiù qualcuno mi ama
programme.desc: Ritratto di Massimo Troisi in un documentario di Mario Martone. Le tante sfaccettature dell'indimenticato artista partenopeo attraverso materiali inediti e testimonianze di chi lo ha amato.

programme.title: Bombshell - La voce dello scandalo
programme.desc: Charlize Theron, Nicole Kidman e Margot Robbie nel biopic che ricostruisce il caso Roger Ailey. Il potente capo di Fox News viene accusato di molestie sessuali dalle sue dipendenti.

programme.title: Un eroe
programme.desc: Grand Prix della Giuria a Cannes per il pluripremiato Asghar Farhadi. Un detenuto rinuncia a una borsa piena d'oro restituendola al proprietario. Diventera' un eroe ma con esiti imprevisti.

programme.title: Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood, Amy Adams e Justin Timberlake in un film su padri e figli. Un anziano talent-scout del baseball ricuce il rapporto con la figlia mentre cerca un nuovo campione da lanciare.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Penguin Bloom
programme.desc: Naomi Watts e Andrew Lincoln in un'emozionante storia vera. Paralizzata a causa di un incidente, una donna trova il coraggio di ricominciare prendendosi cura di una gazza ferita.

programme.title: Campo di battaglia
programme.desc: Alessandro Borghi e Gabriel Montesi nel film di Gianni Amelio. Durante la Grande Guerra e l’epidemia di febbre spagnola l’amicizia tra 2 medici è minata dal diverso approccio etico.

programme.title: Leonora addio
programme.desc: Paolo Taviani omaggia Pirandello in un film premiato a Berlino. Dopo la morte dello scrittore, un emissario comunale intraprende un viaggio da Roma ad Agrigento per trasportarne le ceneri.

programme.title: Ocean's 8
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Cate Blanchett, Anne Hathaway e Rihanna in un'action-comedy dal regista di "Hunger Games'. Dopo cinque anni in carcere a preparare il colpo perfetto, Debbie Ocean passa all'azione e raduna una squadra di rapinatrici: vuole approfittare di una festa da ballo per rubare una collana di diamanti del valore di 150 milioni di dollari custodita all'interno del Metropolitan Museum di New York. Sequel in versione femminile della trilogia formata da "Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco', "Ocean's Twelve' e "Ocean's Thirteen', diretta da Steven Soderbergh, qui in veste di produttore.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco
programme.desc: Colpo grosso a Las Vegas per George Clooney, Brad Pitt e un cast di stelle. Un ex galeotto raduna dieci complici per rapinare un caveau nella capitale del gioco d'azzardo.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: Torna il super cast diretto da Steven Soderbergh nel sequel di "Ocean's Eleven". Per restituire i soldi del primo colpo, gli undici di Ocean sono costretti ad organizzare 3 colpi in Europa.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: George Clooney, Brad Pitt e il resto della banda nel terzo capitolo della saga. I professionisti del furto devono saccheggiare il casino' di un magnate interpretato da Al Pacino.

programme.title: Playmobil: The Movie
programme.desc: Primo lungometraggio animato ispirato ai celebri giocattoli. Gli orfani Marla e Charlie vengono catapultati nel mondo dei Playmobil, nel bel mezzo di una battaglia tra vichinghi.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Dagli autori di "Cattivissimo me", lo spin-off che ripercorre la storia dei buffi personaggi, sempre alla ricerca di un cattivo da servire: dalla Preistoria fino alla Londra degli anni 60.

programme.title: Mia e il leone bianco
programme.desc: Daniah De Villiers e Mélanie Laurent nella toccante storia di un legame impossibile. Trasferitasi in Sudafrica con i genitori, Mia stringe amicizia con un cucciolo di leone bianco.

programme.title: Sonic - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden, fra live action e animazione, nell’avventura basata sulla serie di videogiochi della Sega. Sonic, un porcospino più veloce del suono, approda sulla Terra per sfuggire ai cacciatori che lo braccano e si ritrova ad affrontare un diabolico scienziato.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.title: Mio fratello rincorre i dinosauri
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Isabella Ragonese in una pellicola di formazione di Stefano Cipani. Un adolescente si confronta con la disabilita' del fratellino, affetto dalla sindrome di Down.

programme.title: Biancaneve e il cacciatore
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth e Charlize Theron nella rilettura della famosa fiaba. La crudele regina incarica un cacciatore di uccidere la figliastra Biancaneve, in fuga verso il bosco.

programme.title: Troppo Napoletano
programme.desc: Commedia di Gianluca Ansanelli con Serena Rossi e prodotta da Alessandro Siani. In preda ai primi turbamenti d'amore, il piccolo Ciro si allea con il suo analista per conquistare l'amata.

programme.title: Max Steel
programme.desc: Fanta-action ispirato al giocattolo della Mattel e all'omonimo cartoon. Max, figlio di uno scienziato morto misteriosamente, scopre di avere poteri sovrumani grazie a un amico alieno.

programme.title: Ghosthunters - Gli acchiappafantasmi
programme.desc: A caccia di spettri in una commedia fantastica. Tom fa amicizia con il fantasmino Hugo e chiede aiuto a un'investigatrice dell'occulto per aiutarlo a tornare a casa.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - L'avventura continua
programme.desc: Secondo film tratto dai romanzi di Cecile Aubry. Sebastien non crede alla morte di Angelina e parte alla sua ricerca insieme a Belle. Durante il viaggio, una scoperta cambiera' la sua vita.

programme.title: Mio fratello rincorre i dinosauri
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Isabella Ragonese in una pellicola di formazione di Stefano Cipani. Un adolescente si confronta con la disabilita' del fratellino, affetto dalla sindrome di Down.

programme.title: Sonic - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden, fra live action e animazione, nell’avventura basata sulla serie di videogiochi della Sega. Sonic, un porcospino più veloce del suono, approda sulla Terra per sfuggire ai cacciatori che lo braccano e si ritrova ad affrontare un diabolico scienziato.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un film d'animazione con le allegre creature dal ciuffo ribelle. La principessa Poppy e il malinconico Branch devono salvare i Trolls dai loro mortali nemici.

programme.title: La Befana vien di notte II - Le origini
programme.desc: Prequel con Monica Bellucci, Fabio De Luigi e Zoe Massenti tra avventure e incantesimi. Una giovane orfana entra in conflitto con un avido barone, ma una strega gentile la salvera'.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - L'avventura continua
programme.desc: Secondo film tratto dai romanzi di Cecile Aubry. Sebastien non crede alla morte di Angelina e parte alla sua ricerca insieme a Belle. Durante il viaggio, una scoperta cambiera' la sua vita.

programme.title: Troppo Napoletano
programme.desc: Commedia di Gianluca Ansanelli con Serena Rossi e prodotta da Alessandro Siani. In preda ai primi turbamenti d'amore, il piccolo Ciro si allea con il suo analista per conquistare l'amata.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo
programme.desc: Commedia di grande successo per tutta la famiglia diretta e interpretata da Alessandro Siani. Un impresario teatrale deve difendere un bambino speciale da un team di scienziati.

programme.title: Lego Batman - Il film
programme.desc: Animazione digitale e mattoncini Lego si combinano di nuovo per un’avventura targata DC. Batman si allea con la Justice League per sconfiggere i supercattivi capitanati da Joker.

programme.title: Paws of Fury: La leggenda di Hank

La famiglia Perron - padre, madre e cinque figlie femmine - si e' appena trasferita in una nuova casa in campagna dove sono stati accolti da rumori inquietanti e strane apparizioni, che ben presto degenerano in vere e proprie manifestazioni paranormali. Terrorizzati, i coniugi Perron chiedono aiuto a due investigatori specializzati nella lotta contro presenze demoniache.

programme.desc: Questo O Quello - Ghostbusters.

Nella Capitale incontra un reporter americano, sull'orlo del licenziamento, che le propone una 'vacanza alternativa', lontano dai rigidi e noiosi cerimoniali del protocollo. Fuggita da palazzo, vivra' una romantica avventura, scoprendo grazie al suo accompagnatore il vero volto della citta'. Ma i giornali sono sulle tracce della principessa e lo scoop e' in agguato...

Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.title: Bleed - Più forte del destino
programme.desc: Miles Teller nell'esaltante storia del pugile Vinny Pazienza. Reduce da un terribile incidente, il tenace campione non si arrende e torna sul ring per combattere un match leggendario.

programme.title: La vita accanto
programme.desc: Marco Tullio Giordana dirige una pellicola con Sonia Bergamasco e Paolo Pierobon. La nascita di Rebecca, con una macchia rossa sul viso, getta nello sconforto una ricca famiglia.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: 5 Oscar a un film simbolo degli anni 90, con Kevin Spacey e Annette Bening, diretti da Sam Mendes. Un quarantenne insoddisfatto si invaghisce di una compagna di scuola di sua figlia.

programme.title: Le confessioni
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Pierfrancesco Favino nella pellicola di Roberto Ando'. In un albergo di lusso sta per riunirsi il G8 dei ministri dell'economia per decidere il futuro del mondo occidentale.

programme.title: Tornare
programme.desc: Cristina Comencini dirige Giovanna Mezzogiorno in un dramma psicologico. Alice torna in Italia per il funerale di suo padre e viene travolta dai ricordi della propria giovinezza.

programme.title: La scandalosa vita di Bettie Page
programme.desc: Dalla regista di 'American Psycho', la biografia della nota pin up degli anni 50. Arrivata a New York con il sogno di fare l'attrice, Bettie (Gretchen Mol, interprete di "Boardwalk Empire") diventera' la prima famosa modella di bondage e l'icona della liberta' sessuale in un'America attratta dal proibito: per tutti, "The Pin-Up Queen of the Universe". Finira' per esser chiamata come testimone davanti al Senato degli Stati Uniti nell'inchiesta sugli effetti della visione di materiale pornografico sugli adolescenti americani.

programme.title: Back to Black
programme.desc: Sam Taylor-Johnson dirige un intenso biopic sulla cantautrice britannica Amy Winehouse: dagli esordi come cantante jazz fino a diventare un'icona della discografia mondiale.

programme.title: Il professore e il pazzo
programme.desc: Mel Gibson e Sean Penn nel resoconto di una storica impresa. 1879: per redigere il primo dizionario di inglese, un accademico di Oxford riceve l'aiuto di un reduce rinchiuso in manicomio.

programme.title: La vita accanto
programme.desc: Marco Tullio Giordana dirige una pellicola con Sonia Bergamasco e Paolo Pierobon. La nascita di Rebecca, con una macchia rossa sul viso, getta nello sconforto una ricca famiglia.

programme.title: Il colore viola
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Whoopi Goldberg nello spettacolare affresco storico di Steven Spielberg. America, anni 20: la storia di una ragazza di colore violentata e trattata come una schiava.

programme.title: A Good Person
programme.desc: Florence Pugh e Morgan Freeman in un film Sky Original di Zach Braff. Sopravvissuta a un incidente, una giovane donna prova a ricostruire la sua vita con l'aiuto dell'aspirante suocero.

programme.title: 18 regali
programme.desc: Ispirato a una storia vera, Francesco Amato dirige Vittoria Puccini, Benedetta Porcaroli ed Edoardo Leo. Una donna incinta reagisce a un destino crudele con un’idea speciale per sua figlia.
3 Oscar al capolavoro bellico di Sam Mendes con George MacKay e un grande cast. Due soldati inglesi sono incaricati di portare in territorio nemico un messaggio che salverebbe molte vite.

programme.title: Vice - L'uomo nell'ombra
programme.desc: Oscar al trucco per il biopic di Adam McKay con Christian Bale, Amy Adams e Sam Rockwell. La storia di Dick Cheney, controverso vicepresidente americano durante i mandati di George W. Bush.

programme.title: Molto forte, incredibilmente vicino
programme.desc: Toccante storia con Tom Hanks e Max von Sydow, dal romanzo di Jonathan Safran Foer. Un bambino insegue il mistero di una chiave appartenuta al padre, morto nell'attentato dell'11 settembre.

programme.title: Cinema verite
programme.desc: Diane Lane e Tim Robbins in una pellicola HBO sul primo reality-show della storia della tv. 1973: una famiglia americana accetta di vivere sotto l'occhio delle telecamere 24 ore su 24.

programme.title: Lansky - Un cervello al servizio della mafia
programme.desc: Richard Dreyfuss nella storia del gangster Meyer Lansky. Nell'America del Proibizionismo, la scalata al crimine del celebre boss e il suo sodalizio con Lucky Luciano e Bugsy Siegel.

programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Mark Ruffalo in una commovente produzione HBO. New York, 1981: uno scrittore e una dottoressa ingaggiano una lotta per sensibilizzare l'opinione pubblica sul virus HIV.

programme.title: Accadde in Aprile
programme.desc: Idris Elba nella pellicola che ripercorre il genocidio dei ruandesi Tutsi per mano degli Hutu, attraverso la storia di due fratelli che si ritrovano ai lati opposti della barricata.

programme.title: La nostra storia
programme.desc: Javier Camara nel racconto di una famiglia e della Colombia degli anni 70 e 80. Tornato a Medellin, Hector evoca la figura del padre, medico e attivista inviso al regime paramilitare.

programme.desc: 7 Oscar al kolossal di Steven Spielberg con Liam Neeson e Ben Kingsley. La vera storia del tedesco Oskar Schindler che salvò centinaia di ebrei dalla Shoah, impiegandoli nella sua fabbrica.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.title: C'era una volta in America
programme.desc: Versione estesa e restaurata del capolavoro di Sergio Leone con Robert De Niro sulle note di Ennio Morricone. L'ascesa e il declino di due gangster divisi dall'amore per la stessa donna.

programme.title: Attacco a Mumbai - Una vera storia di coraggio
programme.desc: L’inferno del terrorismo in un infuocato dramma tratto da una storia vera, con Armie Hammer e Dev Patel. Nel novembre 2008 un gruppo di jihadisti armati sbarca a Mumbai per compiere una serie di attentati in vari punti della città e prendere d’assalto un storico albergo di lusso.

programme.title: Manchester by The Sea
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al superbo dramma intimista con Casey Affleck e Michelle Williams. Dopo la morte del fratello maggiore, Lee torna nella sua cittadina per prendersi cura del nipote adolescente.

programme.title: C'era una volta in America
programme.desc: Versione estesa e restaurata del capolavoro di Sergio Leone con Robert De Niro sulle note di Ennio Morricone. L'ascesa e il declino di due gangster divisi dall'amore per la stessa donna.

programme.desc: Emozionante pellicola di Leonardo D'Agostini con Stefano Accorsi e Andrea Carpenzano. Per disciplinare un giovane fuoriclasse, il presidente gli affianca un insegnante privato.

programme.title: Colpo grosso

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: A wish-granting toad drops into Yi and the crew’s life just as the dumpling shop is being reviewed by a food magazine writer. As a result of granting an abundance of wishes for the whole crew, the toad becomes too weak to continue. programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City

With Yi and Jin tied up in their respective CNY festival performances, Peng and a semi-disguised Everest hit the festive streets, eating and enjoying everything in sight. Meanwhile, while paying respects to her late father at a temple, Yi panics when an accident breaks her magical violin strings. She hurries back to find her friends, only to spot Peng and Everest and watch them get snatched up by a menacing, mysterious creature!

programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Yi realizes that Peng and Everest were taken by Nian, the legendary dragon-like creature associated with Chinese New Year – and he’s also taken their other creature friends! With Burnish and Duchess’ help, Yi and Jin travel outside of the city to find Nian’s cave. But a skirmish in the cave drives the conflict with Nian back to the city, wreacking havoc on the festival. The crew and creatures band together to try to stop Nian, but they’re no match. Will Yi be able to create magic and connect with the troubled creature without Everest’s magic strings on her violin?

programme.title: Para sa Isa't Isa ep 3
programme.desc: Zion gets another shot at repairing his relationship with his wife, Erin by a wish on a well to go back in time. But he finds Erin not knowing him at all. He must now correct his mistakes and make her fall in love with him again.

programme.title: For the Love ep 13
programme.desc: An episodic TV series touching on various kinds of love stories based on modern hits and classics from Viva Records.

programme.title: From the Beautiful Country ep 3
programme.desc: A Sari-Sari original series. Four beauty pageant contestants find themselves prime suspects when another contestant winds up dead. Each girl has her motive, but which one of them did it? And which one will end up with the crown?

programme.title: Lumuhod ka sa Lupa ep 50
programme.desc:
This is a story of revenge by Norman Dela Cruz, a 
loving son, and he aspires to become a lawyer for 
the underprivileged. After his mother was killed, he 
vowed to seek revenge against the influential 
retired judge, Benito Balmores.

programme.title: Minsan Pa Natin Hagkan ang Nakaraan ep 25
programme.desc: A woman who was severely broken by her greatest love finds love again in an older man who did everything to put her back together. Just when she thought her life is finally back to normal, her greatest love comes back, determined to work for her forgiveness and win her back—even if it means breaking her family apart.

programme.title: Totoy Bato ep 105
programme.desc: Totoy Bato explores the origins, the pathos of the character Totoy. All the different battle he went through (terrorist, revenge for his wife, corruption, prejudice and for love) defines him as a character.

programme.title: Fallen
programme.desc: Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: When two terrorists kidnap former soldier Michael Knox's niece, he employs all of his skills to rescue her and possibly foil a plan of mass destruction as well.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part
programme.desc: Five years after saving the Lego world, Emmet must once again save everyone with the help of Rex Dangervest when new enemies from outer space attack them.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Steppenwolf and his Parademons return after aeons to destroy Earth. However, Batman seeks the help of Wonder Woman to recruit The Flash, Cyborg and Aquaman to fight their new powerful enemy.

programme.title: Piranha 3D
programme.desc: An earthquake cracks open the bottom of a lake, releasing a prehistoric species of piranha. As sinister events unfold due to the flesh-eating fish, a group of strangers team up to stop the bloodbath.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Circumstances force Rocky to retire from boxing. However, he soon accepts to train a young boxer named Tommy Gunn at his older trainer Mickey Goldmill's gym.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After putting an end to the dystopian Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and her friends attempt to rescue a brainwashed companion and free their nation from the control of President Coriolanus Snow.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: John, son of Sarah Connor, sends a reprogrammed Terminator to protect his younger self, who also holds the key to humanity's survival, from the T-1000, an advanced robot created by Skynet.

programme.title: GoldenEye
programme.desc: Agent 007, along with Natalia Simonav, travels to Russia to locate the satellite nuclear weapon stolen by Alec, a former agent, who Bond believed was dead.

programme.title: Set Up
programme.desc: After his friend betrays him and disappears with the stolen goods, Sonny seeks vengeance. Subsequently, he partners up with a dangerous mob boss to achieve his goal.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: An archeology expert joins an Indian professor to look for a lost treasure of India. However, things take a dangerous turn when they are ambushed in their quest.

programme.title: Stars!
programme.desc: The host sheds light on various popular individuals from different walks of life and highlights their individual journeys to stardom.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: After a woman abandons her child, the Tramp finds him and takes him under his wing. As the boy grows up, the Tramp and the boy try to cope with life's trials and tribulations.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas, a young man, trains under an elder in order to become the keeper of his community's memories. However, things get complicated once he discovers the sinister side of his city.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Courtney Collins, a single mother, relocates to a rural home with her twin sons. Later, she discovers it's inhabited by malevolent spirits connected to the sinister entity Bughuul.

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: With the help of warrior Rita Vrataski, Major William Cage has to save Earth and the human race from an alien species, after being caught in a time loop.
